observations.body: When people wonder whether John is the Christ, he points to one mightier and speaks of Spirit, fire, wheat, chaff, and good news.
observations.label: Expectation turns toward the coming one

payload.posture: Read Luke 3:15–18 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states when people wonder whether John is the Christ, he points to one mightier and speaks of Spirit, fire, wheat, chaff, and good news. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
payload.title: Expectation turns toward the coming one
